note: He is the good-to-great case almost perfectly — six years consistent, 68 kg at 169 cm, weighted pull-ups, a half marathon booked, chasing the last increment he has never reached. He is emphatically not deconditioned. But he fails the ICP on the two criteria that decide deals. Income: a 1.5k ceiling against a 5.2k euro ask, a 20k car already committed, a wife who has just moved to lower pay, and no cash until the end-of-month paycheck. Neglected health: health is his hobby and his identity, not his blind spot — creatine, magnesium, eight hours' sleep, blue-light blockers, a Whoop. 'Successful' is genuinely borderline — fifteen years and international client-facing seniority in the spirits industry, but an employee rather than the business owner or physician the stated ICP describes — so it is left out of both lists rather than forced.
